title: ask skill: iterate the objectstack-ask skill and the MCP tool descriptions against the travel_expense ask round until it meets a fixed target
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (mailbox #32588, comment 6962850643), on the maintainer's word as relayed by that seat (2026-11-17 22:26Z): 「34951 既然还不完美，是不是应该继续优化问数技能，继续迭代测试」「不要等每天」. This is a fast iteration loop instead of waiting for the daily round (#34869).

Parent: #34659. Dispatch: seat 3 → area o3-F, which already holds the runner and the recordings.

## Why
Day 1 (#34951) and the five-rep round (#34958), on haiku-5-5 medium with the skill:
- 问数 23/25;
- datasets 18/25, with asked-back only 3/10;
- operations 2/3 in every rep;
- 8 questions and 3 operations unmeasured, because the seed refused 584 rows. The fix is in PR #34985 for #34897.

## Loop
1. Read the failing turns in the recordings.
2. Change the skill text (`skills/objectstack-ask/**` and its generated ask-skill data) and/or the MCP tool descriptions.
3. Rerun the with-skill arm, ask only, 5 reps, against the same verified template.
4. Keep a change only when the 5-rep round improves on the last kept one.

One PR per kept change set, `Part of` this card. `skills/**` is governed, so it needs L2.

## Target (with-skill, haiku-5-5 medium, 5 reps, full seed after #34985)
- All 13 questions and 6 operations measured.
- 问数 ≥ 95% of graded questions, and no rep below 90%.
- Metric-selected and fallback-labelled 100%.
- Asked-back ≥ 8/10.
- Operations 100% in every rep.
- 0 leak flags.

## Done when
Two consecutive 5-rep rounds meet the target. Each is recorded as an `eval-run` issue, with a no-skill arm once per round as the comparison.

## Stop rule
Three iterations in a row with no gain → the area reports a diagnosis to seat 3 instead of continuing.

Grade: **p1 · domain:devx · area:ai**. Theme: MCP / 问数 (epic #34659), and the maintainer asked for it directly. Triage does not add a cost line here; the runner uses subscription logins.
